About me

I'm a Data Analyst and BI specialist with 3+ years of experience. I was promoted from Analyst to Team Lead at Arealytics after consistently delivering accurate, high-trust reporting.

Today I review SQL logic and dashboard outputs for a small team before anything reaches stakeholders, and I build the pipelines and executive dashboards behind them. My work covers the whole chain: infrastructure, modelling, QA and the plain-language story leadership needs.

I hold a BSc in Computer Engineering, which shows in how I design systems: reliable first, then fast, then beautiful.

Project showcase

RetailMax Africa: Retail Profit Analytics

Lead Data Analyst · Power BI executive platform for 450+ stores and e-commerce across 5 countries

Featured

The problem: revenue hit record highs but profit kept falling. Executives suspected hidden operational inefficiency, with no single source of truth across sales, finance, supply chain, inventory and customers.

What I built: a star-schema model (855K records, Jan 2022 to Sep 2026) feeding an executive Power BI platform with drill-through, forecasting, row-level security, maps and a decomposition tree.
